status: direction for one Unity trial; review-only, no production adoption, protected-sight patch stays HOLD
author: Vela (Opus 5.5), 2026-10-29
coordinates: Same local frame as ../oldtown-foliage-reuse/manifest.json: Blender metres, +x along the run, +z up, origin = trough pivot (bottom centre). Export: Unity (-x,z,y), then Unity yaw = -world.kit.yaw. For both troughs (kit yaw -1.5708) local x maps to world z = at.z + x and local y to world x = at.x + y.
envelope: Every instance must sit inside the current renderer envelope of its trough: |y| <= 0.34 (coping), |x| <= 2.0 (container), top z <= current planting top. Pivots, proportions, UVs, normals and all submeshes of the source FBX kept; uniform scale only; yaw in quarter turns only (keeps the axis-aligned footprint inside the coping).

troughs.verdict: ADJUST: the old PlazaLayout cafe-terrace-edge recipe exactly (two FlowerBeds at +-1 m, scale 1)
troughs.container: retain current DK_PlanterRun_4_B slot 0 only (60 tris, DK_Limestone -> DK_Limestone_Tex restyle binding unchanged); slots 1-4 (current dome planting) not drawn
troughs.fallbackZ: 0.687 if any droop card shows through the trough body below the coping lip (puts the whole droop inside the 0.600-0.655 coping band; top 1.0613 <= 1.0616)

troughs.verdict: ADJUST: ShrubMound hedge as in the old PlazaLayout facade hedge, at the largest uniform scale the current envelope allows, packed to a continuous run
troughs.container: retain current DK_PlanterRun_4_A slot 0 only (60 tris, restyle binding unchanged); slots 1-4 not drawn
troughs.scaleDerivation: height-bound: (1.1201 - 0.645) / 0.7281 = 0.6525; width-bound 0.68 / 0.993 = 0.685; 0.64 leaves ~9 mm of headroom
troughs.fallback: if frame cost fails on the Air: 5 instances at x = (i-2) * 0.75, same scale and yaws [0,180,90,270,0] (gappier, nearer the old hedge's 2 m spacing ratio); never a smaller scale

palms.verdict: NO CHANGE: geometry, slots, UVs and normals already identical to the original; materials differ only by shader GUID. Not part of the trial.

materialAlternate.note: Kit/Materials/DK_Leaf_CoreShrub.mat, DK_Leaf_Shrub.mat, DK_Flower_Coral.mat differ from the OldTown originals only in m_Shader (current DecoKit/Lit Cutaway 2529b421... vs OldTown/DecoKit/Lit Cutaway 92902edf...). Use only as a recorded fallback if the OldTown shader misbehaves in the play scene; say so in the evidence.
